detail.longDescription:
I’m not an AI hater by any means but can we keep it off Mastodon? I feel like this is one of the few corpo-free and truly human spaces on the internet and well I personally would like to keep it that way… 

Seeing AI generated images, text, but most of all PROFILES just feels so jarring to see here. 

I can’t be the only one who feels this way?

#AI #aislop #aiagents #mastodon
